budget.rounding: Round 120% of (largest successful body + largest successful-job overhead) up to a five-minute interval.
budget.supersedes: The partial 23-body snapshot used 1387 + 49 seconds and proposed 30 minutes. Three later successful bodies took 1909, 1919 and 1930 seconds, refuting that cap.

limitations: Five bakes are a short follow-up, not a guarantee against rare future checkout tails.
Measurement refs predate T-1245; eight stage 3-6 failures are inherited triangle-budget failures also present in unchanged baseline. Target dev includes that fix.

Run #611 has five cancelled smoke bodies after the final workflow push superseded its branch. All eight checkout steps completed successfully before cancellation; cancelled bodies are excluded from successful-duration sizing.
All 40 jobs have reached terminal states: 27 success, 8 failure, 5 cancelled. This is not a claim of five green renderer matrices.
